purpose: Hard identity contract for every Dominic generation. Real user-supplied photos and real user-video-derived frames are the only permitted facial identity authority.
separationRules: Identity sources define face geometry, hair, brows, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, stubble and skin tone.
Motion/performance sources may define only movement, rhythm, posture, gaze behavior and micro-expression vocabulary.
Scene, wardrobe and lighting references may never redefine the face.
When a real identity source cannot be materialized, generation must stop instead of substituting another face.
generationRules: For image-to-video, initialize from an allowed real identity source.
Prefer minimal animation until identity stability is proven.
Never use a generated portrait as first frame, last frame or identity restore source.
Never approve a candidate from technical QA alone.
rejectRules: Reject if the face is not unmistakably the same Dominic as the real reference pack.
Reject if jaw, eye spacing, brows, nose, mouth, hairline, stubble or skin tone visibly drift.
Reject if any sampled frame becomes another man.
Reject if start or end frames contain gray/blank/partial-face artifacts.
Reject if identity source provenance is not real-user-supplied or real-user-video-derived.
